svg.title: How one layer becomes tiles
svg.text: Layer 8; each bar is one wave's output, cut into one task per worker (shades alternate per task, numbers are workers)
QKV: 20 tasks of 153 or 154 rows, 0.6 MB of weights each
[Q; K; V] rows, 3,072 × 2,048; RMSNorm(x) recomputed in every task
Wo: 20 tasks of 102 or 103 rows, 0.4 MB of weights each
Wo rows, 2,048 × 2,048; plus the residual add
FFN: 20 tasks of 409 or 410 rows, 5.0 MB of weights each
gate/up rows and Wdown columns, 8,192 of them; SiLU(gate)·up, then an FP32 down partial over all 2,048 outputs
FFN reduce: 20 tasks of 102 or 103 rows
output rows, 2,048; sum of the 20 partials in a fixed order, + residual
Attention: one task per K/V head (4 query heads each) and context chunk
Each task rotates its Q and K rows (RoPE) and the chunk-0 task writes the K cache row; V is written by QKV
